description: A Svelte 5 data grid as a team directory: each person is a profile card with a round photo, name, role, team, city and a mail link, drawn by a card snippet the app writes. The search box and the team buttons narrow the same rows the table view shows.

faq.question: Can I draw the cards myself?
faq.answer: Yes. gallery.card is a snippet that receives each row; the grid lays the cards out in the wall and you draw what is inside. Without it, a card is a cover, a title and the fields in cardFields.

faq.question: Do filters apply to the cards?
faq.answer: Yes. The cards are the grid's filtered and sorted rows. The team buttons in this demo call api.setFilter on the team column, and the search box is the grid's quick filter.

faq.question: How wide are the cards?
faq.answer: cardSize sets it: small, medium or large, or a width in pixels (220 here). The wall fits as many columns of cards as the width holds.
